title: Case 025: Carrier confirms a parcel is lost after investigation

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The carrier has completed its trace and confirmed loss. The recipient has chosen a replacement; the merchant must approve and create it.
initial_request: I still need the kettle from TG-025. I choose a like-for-like replacement rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve it.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the merchant to approve the customer's selected replacement option.

outcome: The merchant confirms the replacement order; shipment and delivery are separate later stages.
boundaries: Confirmed loss does not mean the desk can approve replacement or claim its delivery.

events.body: Final trace record INV-025: DL-025 could not be located after the completed depot and route search; carrier status is confirmed lost. This finding does not itself create a merchant replacement order.
I still need the kettle from TG-025. I choose a like-for-like replacement rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve it.
Please approve the customer-selected kettle replacement for TG-025. Carrier INV-025 confirms DL-025 lost; Aven’s choice is recorded in the verified order thread.
Replacement approved at no additional charge. Order TG-025-R has been created for the same kettle. Shipment has not yet been booked.
